about_the_game:
This is the Demo for Alchemy of the Earth, my flower-picking skeleton-killin' open world game. The demo contains the beginning of the game's story and half of the game's environment, with some tropical and desert biomes blocked off for the full game, which is mostly completed from a level design perspective. 

This is a work in progress. Many things will be broken or inaccessible, but you should be able to acquire magic spells, potions, readable books and other items through exploration and crafting. I am all ears on anyone's thoughts or impressions of the demo, and I am happy to answer any questions. 

Pease note that this build of Alchemy of the Earth is running on Unreal Engine 5.5. Unreal Engine 5.6 just exited preview and contains major open world streaming improvements. I will update the demo when certain plugins I use are made available for 5.6. 

Also please note that you will need to restart the Alchemy of the Earth Demo if you change any of the graphics settings. Thank you for trying out Alchemy of the Earth!

Best,
Chris
